text:
Alex: Kicking off green pulse shift for router-service v2 -> v2-green. Starting at 10% traffic now. Change window 14:00-15:00 UTC.
DeployBot: [automated] Shift request accepted — service=router namespace=prod strategy=pulse start=10% step=10% health-gates=basic,link_to_runbook: https://redwood/release/runbooks/router-pulse
Alex: running the deploy cli now:
`/deploy router --image=router:v2-green --strategy=pulse --start=10 --step=10`
Sophia: +1 to proceed, but please pin v1 blue for critical routes (session endpoints).
Samir: Leaving a note: set cookie affinity for session endpoints while we exercise route. Cookie name=RWT.
DeployBot: Shift in progress: green=10% -> timestamp=1714001250
Maria: Observability: small uptick in 5xx on green at ~1714001300 — 5xx_rate_green=0.9% (baseline blue=0.08%). p50_green=220ms p95_green=1.8s.
Kevin: Hold on further steps until p95 < 1.2s and 5xx < 0.2%. We should not hit 30% if errors are trending up.
Alex: pausing automated progression. Can ops try a quick curl healthcheck against a green instance?
Maria: Ran quick checks from us-east probe:
`curl -s -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" -o /dev/null https://green-router.prod/api/health` -> `502 0.12s` on node-3, node-1/2 healthy (200).
Maria: Extract from node-3 logs:
```
ERROR upstream: failed to read response
trace id=fe12a3b
at proxy/handler.go:142
cause: missing header X-Forwarded-Proto
```
Alex: interesting — seems node-specific. Possibly env var not set on that green replica. Samir, can you check deploy job env?
Samir: I'm on it — fetching pod manifest now. Quick fix could be env sync + restart.
DeployBot: For visibility: automated step to 20% canceled by user at 1714001345.
Kevin: Given intermittent 502s, recommend rollback to 0% and drain green. Risk to production sessions if we let it sit.
Sophia: Agreed. Also we should pin route version for /sessions to blue before rollback to ensure no sticky mismatch.
Alex: Ok executing rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback router --target=blue --set-green=0`
DeployBot: Rollback initiated — setting green traffic to 0%. Draining green connections for 300s. rollback_id=rb-1714001360
Maria: Confirming metrics now: green 5xx quickly falling as traffic shifts back. p95 overall back to 0.95s.
DeployBot: Rollback complete at 1714001460. All traffic routed to blue.
Alex: Thanks. Action items: 1) Samir to patch env var on green image and add preflight to CI; 2) Maria to run targeted synthetic tests against green before next pulse; 3) Sophia to add a release-note entry and version pin for /sessions.
Samir: Patch queued. Will cut v2.0.1 with env fix and smoke tests. ETA ~2h.
Maria: I'll open a quick incident note with graphs and attach logs (will add to the runbook).
Sophia: For the next attempt: smaller steps (5% increments), stricter health gates (error budget 0.1%, p95 < 1.2s), and an explicit cookie affinity pin for session routes.
Alex: Agreed. We'll repro in staging and re-run pulse after v2.0.1. Good rollback — :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Final status: rollback=true release=router:v2-green flagged_for_redeploy=false ticket=ENG-5421
Kevin: Post-mortem checklist: add automated preflight that hits node-specific endpoints and validates headers.
Alex: I'll add the items to the release notes and mark this deployment as aborted for now.
Sophia: Thanks everyone — re-open thread when patch is ready. :rotating_light:
